Title: MemorySmith.Agent — Current Phase Status (Sprint 59+)
Content:
Phases 0-4 complete. Phase 5 (intent reliability, adaptive execution, observation-driven replanning) active through Sprints 41-59. See roadmap.md for future phase planning.

## Phase 0 (Skeleton)
All interfaces, wiki pages, CI baseline. Agent.Core with IGoal, IWorldAdapter, IToolCaller, etc.

## Phase 1 (Core MVP)
MinecraftAdapter.ConnectAsync with subprocess launch and port-wait, MoveToTool, StatusTool, AgentBackgroundService hosted loop.

## Phase 2 (Memory)
RestMemoryGateway (IHttpClientFactory), SearchMemoryTool, GetPageTool, CreatePageTool, MockMemoryGateway. SearchResult.Kind disambiguates page slugs from memory UUIDs.

## Phase 3 (Planner)
HtnPlanner (await/try-catch ReplanAsync), HtnTaskLibrary (8 task methods), GatherWoodGoal, SurviveNightGoal, IGoalFactory, GoalFactory, POST /api/agent/plan, GET /api/goals.

## Phase 4 (Sprint 40 — complete)
ActionData.Context bag, WebSocketBridge with background receive loop, MineflayerAdapter/index.js with pathfinder. Block position off-by-one fixed (findBestBlock three-pass scorer + Y-penalty + grass_block alias). Dig infinite-loop fixed (MAX_DIG_FAILURES=3). Stall retry graduated from 60s fixed to [10,20,30,60]s with chat notification. 63 tests green.

## Phase 5 (Sprints 41-59 — applying)

### Sprint 41-42
TaskSequenceGoal implementation. PlaceBlock concurrency model (maxConcurrentPlaceBlock=8, _placeBlockContexts ConcurrentDictionary). Emergency stop clears _placeBlockContexts.

### Sprint 43
Selective CancelGoal: conflicting goals (gather, build, craft) trigger emergency stop; idle/wander goals just clear queue without adapter flush. Prevents unnecessary adapter queue flushes.

### Sprint 44
Stale _placeBlockContexts cleanup in SweepTimedOutActions. SmeltItem timeout set to 45s (must exceed JS adapter SMELT_TIMEOUT_MS=40s). Council review.

### Sprint 51
"Not in inventory" fast-path recovery (TryExtractMissingMaterial → direct GatherGoal). Creative mode guard skips gather in creative mode.

### Sprint 52
ChatHistory for recording bot responses into LLM system prompt. Safety options (DeniedCommands). Configurable maxConcurrentPlaceBlock and chatMaxResponseLength.

### Sprint 54 (TSK-0199, TSK-0203, TSK-0205, TSK-0221, TSK-0226)
Chat response splitting (chatMaxResponseLength=500). IMemoryGateway for cross-session fact persistence (LoadSessionFactsAsync). TaskSequenceGoal from chat intents. GetStatus timeout escalation (2 consecutive → clears IsInventoryStale). Auto-skip after 3 consecutive place timeouts (_blockTimeoutCounts).

### Sprint 55 (TSK-0155, TSK-0165)
Pre-dispatch WorldState snapshot (_preDispatchSnapshot). Entity observation (EntityObservedEvent, EntitiesQueriedEvent, BlockBelowChangedEvent). Action lifecycle telemetry events (actionStarted, actionProgress, actionFailed, actionCompleted).

### Sprint 56 (TSK-0270, TSK-0286)
PlaceBlock timeout increased from 5s to 15s (pathfinding round-trip). SafetyOptions with DeniedCommands.

### Sprint 57 (TSK-0302)
InventorySyncLoopAsync — 4th concurrent loop, periodic inventory refresh every 30s, prevents silent inventory drift.

### Sprint 58 Wave C (TSK-0309, TSK-0325, TSK-0331, TSK-0332)
WorldModel for predict-before-dispatch and reconcile-after-completion (IWorldModel). LLM evaluator circuit breaker (3 consecutive failures → 60s cooldown). Goal provisioning CTS (_goalProvisioningCts). Mine timeout set to 15s (fail fast on blocked blocks).

### Sprint 59 (TSK-0320)
LLM evaluator delegates to TaskSequenceGoal current step context. 746+ tests passing.

## Phase 6 (Strategy, not started)
AER recorded. AgentRuntime decomposition into separate services: RecoveryManagerImpl, PlanningManagerImpl, ExecutionManager, StateManager — currently stubs only. Promise/Project structure defined in .github/agents/smith.agent.md.

## Current CI Baseline
746+ tests passing. See agent-testing-infrastructure for details. Repo: https://github.com/TheMasonX/MemorySmith.Agent

## Key Architectural Decisions

| Decision | Sprint | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| Fire-and-forget dispatch | 36 | ActionOutcome universal tool result |
| Per-tool timeouts | 44+ | ToolTimeoutOverrides dictionary |
| PlaceBlock concurrency | 42 | MaxConcurrentForTool with _maxConcurrentPlaceBlock=8 |
| Selective CancelGoal | 43 | Different stop behavior by goal type |
| LLM circuit breaker | 58 | 3 failures → 60s cooldown |
| Inventory sync loop | 57 | 30s periodic refresh |
| WorldModel predict | 58 | Predict-before-dispatch + reconcile |
| Cross-session facts | 54 | IMemoryGateway for persistence |
